leadText: Maylene's Lucario (Japanese: スモモのルカリオ Sumomo's Lucario) is Maylene's main .
plainText:
Maylene's Lucario (Japanese: スモモのルカリオ Sumomo's Lucario) is Maylene's main .

==In animation==
===Pokémon the Series===
==== ====
 
 
Lucario debuted in Lost Leader Strategy!, where it was battling with Maylene. Lucario used to stop the battle of , and . It is also seen battling in a flashback, being easily defeated by , first by being trapped with a , and then being finished off with a uppercut.

In Crossing the Battle Line!, Lucario battled in 's Gym against Maylene. It defeated Dawn's Ambipom and Piplup.

In A Triple Fighting Chance!, Lucario participated in 's Gym battle against Maylene. It defeated Ash's Staravia and , but was knocked out along with Ash's Buizel, resulting in a tie.

In Enter Galactic!, Lucario helped Ash and the others defeat Saturn and Team Galactic.

Lucario reappeared in a flashback in League Unleashed.

Lucario briefly appeared alongside Maylene during the ending credits of Zoroark: Master of Illusions.

===Personality and characteristics===
Lucario did not accept the fact that Maylene gave up after her loss to Paul, as seen in Lost Leader Strategy!, when it fired multiple s and es at her during their training, thought this maybe the result of some where deep down believing that she had what it took to still be a great gym leader. While stern, it cares deeply for her and will not tolerate people talking negatively about Maylene, especially shown when it sends Team Rocket flying for saying how pathetic she was.

===Moves used===
 
 
 
 
 
 

==In the games==
Lucario is Maylene's main Pokémon in the games. It is on her Gym team in , her Pokémon World Tournament team in , as well as being one of her Pokéathletes in .

==In the manga==
 
===Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!===
Maylene sent out Lucario to join in the battle with the other Gym Leader's Pokémon against Team Galactic in The Legendary Pokémon, Captured.
 

==In the TCG==
Lucario appeared in the Rising Rivals expansion. Its card featured the Platinum version of the Veilstone City Gym, and its Level matched the level it had in Pokémon Platinum, as well.
